entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sulayman, sometimes referred to as Sulayman III, was the Crown Prince of the Kingdom of Maynila in the late 16th century and was a nephew of Raja Ache of Luzon. He was the commander of the Tagalog forces in the battle of Manila of 1570 against Spanish forces.
